project.name: Data Model Hardening — Incremental Ingestion & pgvector

summary: Add incremental ingestion with batch tracking and deduplication (transactions_raw staging table), pgvector-based embedding storage replacing pickle caches, and an IncrementalPromoter that processes only new rows through the supplier harmonisation and categorisation pipeline before writing to the enriched transactions table. The goal is to support 1M+ row client datasets uploaded periodically as CSV/Excel, without re-processing previously ingested rows and without any external LLM API calls in the hot path.

decisions.two_table_approach: transactions_raw is the landing zone for every CSV upload; transactions is the enriched fact table. The pipeline promotes rows from raw to enriched. This separates ingestion concerns from analytical concerns and enables incremental processing.
decisions.source_row_hash: SHA256(json.dumps(raw_row_dict, sort_keys=True, default=str)) where raw_row_dict is the original CSV row dict before any transformation. Full-row hash is the most collision-resistant approach and handles null invoice_number gracefully. A re-export with any changed field is treated as a new row — acceptable trade-off for correctness.
decisions.pgvector_as_cache_only: pgvector is used as a persistent embedding cache (store + retrieve by text), not for ANN similarity search. Cosine similarity is still computed in Python using numpy. This keeps the logic simple and avoids pgvector-specific SQL while eliminating pickle files in production.
decisions.pickle_fallback: When SUPABASE_DATABASE_URL is not set (local dev, SQLite tests), embedding stores fall back to the existing pickle cache behaviour. No test changes required.
decisions.incremental_harmonisation: The promoter only runs supplier harmonisation on raw_supplier_name values NOT already present in supplier_master for the engagement. Known names get their canonical_supplier_id looked up directly. This avoids re-running fuzzy/embedding matching on the full supplier master on every batch.
decisions.incremental_categorisation: Categorisation runs on all queued rows in the batch. Rows with category_confidence < 0.60 after all deterministic passes get pipeline_status = 'review_required' and surface in the Review Workstation. No LLM fallback.
decisions.backwards_compatibility: Ingestor.ingest_to_db() is preserved unchanged for all existing tests. The new Ingestor.ingest_to_raw() method is additive. database.py adds ingestion_batches_table and transactions_raw_table to the SQLAlchemy metadata so they are created in SQLite for local dev too.

existing_tables.transactions: Post-pipeline enriched fact table. Will gain a source_raw_id UUID column pointing back to transactions_raw.
existing_tables.supplier_master: Canonical supplier dimension. build_supplier_master() already checks for existing entries before inserting — idempotent.
existing_tables.pipeline_jobs: Tracks FastAPI background job status. Will gain a batch_id column to link job to ingestion batch.
existing_tables.engagements: Multi-tenant root table. All new tables reference engagement_id.

userStories.title: Add migration 003 — ingestion_batches, transactions_raw, embedding tables, pgvector
userStories.description: Create supabase/migrations/003_data_model_hardening.sql. This migration enables the pgvector extension, creates the ingestion_batches and transactions_raw staging tables, creates description_embeddings and supplier_embeddings tables with VECTOR(384) columns and IVFFlat indexes, adds a source_raw_id UUID column to the existing transactions table, and applies RLS policies to all new tables following the existing pattern from 001_initial_schema.sql.

userStories.title: Create src/ingestion/promoter.py — IncrementalPromoter class
userStories.description: Create src/ingestion/promoter.py containing the IncrementalPromoter class. This class reads queued rows from transactions_raw for a specific batch, runs supplier harmonisation only on raw_supplier_name values not already present in supplier_master for the engagement, runs categorisation on all queued rows, writes enriched rows to the transactions table, and marks raw rows as processed or review_required. LLM categorisation is never called — rows below 0.60 confidence go to review_required status.
acceptanceCriteria: Create file: src/ingestion/promoter.py
Class IncrementalPromoter with __init__(self, engine, config) storing both as instance attributes
Method promote(self, engagement_id: str, batch_id: str) -> dict returns dict with keys: promoted_count, review_required_count, failed_count
promote() step 1: call get_queued_raw_rows(engine, engagement_id, batch_id) from src.models.database — if empty DataFrame returned, return early with all counts = 0

promote() step 2: extract unique raw_supplier_names from queued rows; query supplier_master table to find which normalised names are already known for this engagement; run SupplierHarmoniser only for the unknown raw_supplier_names (import from src.suppliers.harmoniser); for known names look up canonical_supplier_id directly from supplier_master
promote() step 3: enrich the queued rows DataFrame with canonical_supplier_id, canonical_supplier_name, canonical_supplier_confidence from step 2 results

promote() step 4: run SpendCategoriser (import from src.categorisation.categoriser) on the enriched queued rows DataFrame; the categoriser must be instantiated with dry_run forced to True (config.llm.dry_run = True) so no LLM calls are made regardless of config
promote() step 5: split result into promoted rows (category_confidence >= 0.60 or categorised by MANUAL/DETERMINISTIC methods) and review_required rows (category_confidence < 0.60 or None)

promote() step 6: call insert_transactions(engine, promoted_records, engagement_id) from src.models.database to write promoted rows to the transactions table; set source_raw_id on each record to the transactions_raw row id

promote() step 7: call mark_raw_rows_processed(engine, promoted_ids, 'processed') for successfully promoted rows and mark_raw_rows_processed(engine, review_ids, 'review_required') for review queue rows
promote() step 8: return counts
Verify: Create file exists — ls src/ingestion/promoter.py
Verify: python -c "from src.ingestion.promoter import IncrementalPromoter; print('import OK')"
